name: Support charge dispute policy example
answer:
Customers must report an unauthorized charge within 60 days.
Support may request transaction details before opening a dispute.
Every disputed charge is automatically refunded within 24 hours.

sources.title: Support Charge Dispute Policy
sources.content:
Customers must report an unauthorized charge within 30 days of noticing it.
Support may request transaction details before opening a dispute.
Dispute outcomes depend on the payment provider's investigation; refunds are not automatic.
